messages:
Aisha (CSM): Quick week0 pulse for AcmeCo private/VPC deploy. Focus: network peering, firewall rules, IAM roles, KMS key access, audit log shipping. Also capturing any renewal risk flags (they're at 10 months left). Can folks post short status + blockers? Thanks :wave:
Tom (NetEng): Network update — peering established to prod VPC, BGP session up, ACLs pending for 10.2.0.0/22. Waiting on customer to approve egress NAT IP list. No latency issues. ETA for ACLs: tomorrow EOD. :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Security): IAM done for service accounts, cross-account role needs explicit condition on aws:SourceVpc — I pushed a policy draft:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-serv"},
  "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0abcde12345"}}
}
```
Need customer to confirm VPC id format, else we'll fallback to IP CIDR condition. Also KMS key policy is permissive atm — suggesting rotation + decrypt-only grant to redwood-serv role. Blocker: no KMS key ARN provided yet.
Lena (Enablement): Runbook checklist sent to their SREs. Smoke tests scheduled for Thu. I need final list of service principals that require monitoring/alerting.
Aisha (CSM): Noted. Renewal risk: flagged as MODERATE because they asked for customer-managed keys + extended audit retention. If KMS/key partitioning isn't resolved in 6 weeks we should escalate to solutions + sales. @Carlos can you own escalation plan? :warning:
Carlos (Solutions): I'll draft escalation note and options (1) dedicated CMK in customer account, (2) Redwood-managed key with VPC-restricted grants, (3) limited KMS proxy pattern. Will post by 12:00 PST.
deploy-bot: ticket #CS-7891 created for ACL approvals (assignee: AcmeNetOps).
Ravi (Security): Also noticed CloudTrail is enabled but target S3 bucket policy blocks deliveries from external accounts — need the bucket ARN to set a cross-account grant. Quick ask to Acme: can you allow PutObject from redwood-logs account? I can paste sample policy.
Tom (NetEng): One more network nit: traceroutes show an MTU mismatch on one hop — likely their inline firewall. Not blocking for now but could affect large payloads. Customer will triage.
Aisha (CSM): Action items summary:
- Acme: approve egress NAT IPs (network)
- Acme: provide KMS key ARN or accept Redwood-managed CMK (security)
- Acme: update S3 policy to allow CloudTrail delivery to redwood-logs account (logging)
- Redwood: Carlos to draft escalation/options by 12:00 PST (solutions)
- Redwood: Lena to run smoke tests once ACLs + IAM + KMS are in place (enablement)
I'll follow up in 48h; please flag any change in status or new blockers. :calendar:
Tom (NetEng): ACK
Ravi (Security): ACK
Lena (Enablement): ACK
Carlos (Solutions): ACK — posting note now.
